description_sq:
*PRONE EKSKLUZIVE*
-Apartament 1+1 i konvertuaar ne 2+1 per shitje, prane Kompleksit Rafaelo ne Fresk ne rrugen Sotir Caci.
-Siperfaqe totale 90m2, dhe neto 81.1 m2, apartamenti ka hapesira te bollshme
*-Ndodhet ne katin e 1 banimi dhe i 2 teknik ne nje pallati te ri e te mire administruar dhe i pajisur me ashensor, ne nje zone te mire te Tiranes, me akses te menjehershem me rrugen kryesore.
*Eshte i organizuar me koridor qe ben shperndarjen e dhomave, sallon ndenje bashke me ambjentin e gatimit, dy dhoma gjumi, nje tualet.
**Me orjentim Jug- Perendim.
description_en: *EXCLUSIVE PROPERTY* - 1+1 apartment converted to 2+1 for sale, near Rafaelo Complex in Fresk on Sotir Caci street. -Total area 90m2, and net 81.1 m2, the apartment has ample spaces *-It is located on the 1st residential and 2nd technical floor in a new and well-managed building equipped with an elevator, in a good area of ​​Tirana, with immediate access to the main road. *It is organized with a corridor that divides the rooms, a living room with a kitchen area, two bedrooms, a bathroom. **With South-West orientation.
